headline: Microsoft says its AI tool beats doctors on diagnosis
summary: Microsoft says its AI diagnostic tool outperforms doctors on hard cases, citing a Science study, though one outlet notes most gains may come from the underlying AI models rather than Microsoft's own system.

claims.statement: Microsoft says its AI diagnostic tool outperforms doctors.

sources.quote: Microsoft says its AI tool is better than doctors at diagnosing conditions
Microsoft’s Mustafa Suleyman says its AI outperforms doctors on hard cases

claims.statement: Microsoft claims the tool can diagnose conditions far more accurately than human doctors.

sources.quote: diagnose conditions up to four times more accurately than human

claims.statement: The claim is based on a study published in the journal Science.

sources.quote: according to a study in Science

discrepancies.explanation: TechCrunch attributes most of the diagnostic improvement to the underlying AI models rather than Microsoft's own system, a caveat the Verge report does not include.

quotes.quote: most of the improvement seems to come from the AI models underneath, not from Microsoft’s system itself
